correctness.rationale: The repaired theorem concerns the minimal complete recognizer, not an unpointed presentation or temporal dynamics. A path of length n determines an input block of length n+2, which extends to a bilateral configuration. This proves word recognition for every length. In the reconstructed subset table the 16 access words reach all 16 masks, including empty. Computing backward origin masks for the four continuations 111, 11001, 0111, 10011 gives exactly 1, 2, 4, 8. Any distinct masks disagree on whether at least one of those words is accepted, proving minimality by distinct right languages. Both an independently written reconstruction and the repaired standalone certificate reproduce the witnesses. No false original formula was found: the frozen forbidden family follows by the constant transition at mask 8 on 0 and the suffix orbit 12→11→14→15; both immediate proper factors are legal. Independently computing D=det(I−zM) and N=[D−det(I−z(M+1eᵀ))]/z by the rank-one determinant identity reproduces both frozen polynomials and the first 12 counts. The live matrix has min(M⁸)=0 and min(M⁹)=2; primitivity and Perron–Frobenius give the frozen spatial entropy, with independently checked root 1.8864996390854936195076 and logarithm 0.6347230691078676926285. Those frozen claims were removed on scope and coverage grounds, not corrected numerically.
residual_risks: The finite access and suffix checks prove all-length DFA minimality only in conjunction with the path-to-bilateral-input correspondence; no temporal, eventual-image, or uniqueness-of-extremizer statement is made.

originality.rationale: This PASS is for the repaired sharp complete state-complexity theorem. The frozen combined finding is not passed as distinct: the earlier indexed first-offender result already covers strict soficity and its constructive product graph also yields the displayed obstruction family by a fixed transition calculation. The all-rule entropy catalogue gives the exact same Perron entropy and characteristic polynomial (it is indexed the next day, not assigned priority), and makes the matrix-count method explicit. The surviving assertion is the witnessed attainment of the full subset upper bound for this constrained class, not a reachable-subset count, general powerset construction, or a characteristic-polynomial computation. The strongest compared all-rule sources do not establish right-language inequivalence for these reachable subsets. The singleton continuation certificates supply that separate lower bound.
residual_risks: An older or nonindexed Rule 73 or Rule 109 exact minimized table could predate this certificate. Only the noted passages and catalogue entries are compared; no exhaustive priority claim is made.
Later catalogue records show coverage, not priority over the frozen one.

value.rationale: The repaired claim proves that the generic powerset worst-case bound is attainable within the much more constrained local-rule de Bruijn images of elementary binary cellular automata. The exact minimum, rather than the standard bound or a 16-row presentation, matters when assessing whether automata for these image languages can always be compressed. The four diagnostic words give a reusable explicit reason no compression is possible for this rule. Recomputing the known entropy class or first-offender category is not offered as the surviving contribution.
residual_risks: This is attainment, not a classification of all rules attaining it, and no lower bound is claimed for nondeterministic or bi-infinite presentations.
